_comment: FICTIONAL institutional memory of past tenders (for the Procurement Memory & pre-bid prediction demo). In production this is built automatically from every compiled tender, its pre-bid Q&A and corrigenda.

tenders.title: Supply of TMT bars Fe 500D for district hospital extension
tenders.outcome: 2 corrigenda, bid due date extended by 14 days, 1 representation to Chief Engineer

clauses.text: Carbon content shall not exceed 0.18% for better weldability.
prebid_questions: Carbon 0.18% max is stricter than IS 1786 Fe 500D (0.25% max) and only one mill meets it. Please relax to IS 1786 limits.
Please confirm whether bars with carbon up to 0.25% conforming to IS 1786:2008 will be accepted.
clauses.resolution: Corrigendum No. 1 relaxed the limit to 'as per IS 1786:2008 Fe 500D'.

clauses.text: Bars shall be of reputed make like TATA Tiscon or JSW Neosteel only.
prebid_questions: Will ISI-marked bars of other manufacturers be accepted?
clauses.resolution: Clause amended to 'any make conforming to IS 1786:2008 with BIS licence'.

tenders.title: Supply of OPC 43 grade cement for school buildings

clauses.text: Cement shall be OPC 43 grade conforming to IS 8112.
prebid_questions: IS 8112 has been withdrawn and merged into IS 269:2015. Please confirm cement conforming to IS 269:2015 (43 grade) is acceptable.

clauses.text: Each lot shall be tested for 28 days strength before dispatch; delivery within 10 days of order.
prebid_questions: 28-day strength results cannot be available within the 10-day delivery period. Will manufacturer's test certificate of the week of production be accepted?
clauses.resolution: Clarified: MTC accepted; 28-day results on retained samples.

tenders.title: Supply of HDPE pipes for rural water supply

clauses.text: Pipes shall be of good quality and as per relevant IS codes.
prebid_questions: Please specify the applicable IS and pressure class.

tenders.title: Supply of 1100 V PVC insulated copper cables for hospital wiring

clauses.text: Test certificates should be submitted with supply.
prebid_questions: Are manufacturer's routine test certificates acceptable or are NABL lab reports required?
clauses.resolution: Clarified: type test reports from NABL lab within 3 years + routine test certificates.

tenders.title: Supply of structural steel and TMT bars for flyover
tenders.outcome: Tender cancelled and re-issued after contradiction was pointed out in pre-bid

clauses.text: Yield stress shall not exceed 480 N/mm2 to ensure ductility.
prebid_questions: Clause 7.4 caps yield at 480 N/mm2 while Fe 500D requires minimum 500 N/mm2 — no bar can comply. Please clarify.
clauses.resolution: Tender re-issued; cap replaced by 'actual/nominal yield ratio ≤ 1.25'.

clauses.text: Pre-bid meeting will be held after the bid submission date.
prebid_questions: Please reschedule the pre-bid meeting before the bid due date.

tenders.title: Supply of LED street light luminaires 120 W

clauses.text: Luminaires shall conform to IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 1):2012 with BIS CRS registration, IP66 as per IS/IEC 60529.
